scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @orbit/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @orbit/web --filter @orbit/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm --filter @orbit/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @orbit/web dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm --filter @orbit/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @orbit/api start:dev
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p prisma/tsconfig.json && corepack pnpm --filter @orbit/contracts build && corepack pnpm --recursive --if-present typecheck
